item.title: 本文提出“上下文图”这一异构有向图方法，以“决策-事件”节点为因果连接原语，将AI-RAN中多个智能体的策略、测量、决策与警报组织成可查询的解释层，从而实现对跨智能体决策链的可追溯与可解释分析。
item.description:
上下文图：AI-RAN中可解释的多智能体决策链

Context Graph: Explainable Multi-Agent Decision Chains in AI-RAN

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16879

本文提出“上下文图”这一异构有向图方法，以“决策-事件”节点为因果连接原语，将AI-RAN中多个智能体的策略、测量、决策与警报组织成可查询的解释层，从而实现对跨智能体决策链的可追溯与可解释分析。

AI-RAN（AI无线接入网）将网络控制分布于多个自治智能体上，即在共享无线资源上运行的xApps和rApps。当出现警报或性能退化时，运营商目前缺乏一种结构化方式来追溯是哪个决策导致了问题、什么上下文触发了该决策，以及其他智能体之间是如何交互的。现有的可解释性工具专注于单模型的特征归因或线性事件日志记录，两者都无法捕捉跨智能体的决策链。我们提出了上下文图，这是一种异构有向图，将策略、测量、决策和警报组织成一个可查询的解释层。其基础原语是“决策-事件”节点，充当因果连接点：入边捕捉触发的上下文，出边追踪下游后果，而这些后果会通过反事实验证被逐步确认。基于现有的E2、A1和O1数据流进行实例化，我们的概念验证……（原文摘要到此截断）

arXiv:2611.16879v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI-RAN distributes network control across multiple autonomous agents, namely xApps and rApps operating over shared radio resources. When an alert or degradation appears, operators currently lack a structured way to trace which decision caused it, what context triggered that decision, and how other agents interacted. Existing explainability tools focus on single-model feature attribution or linear event logging, neither of which captures cross-agent decision chains. We propose the Context Graph, a heterogeneous directed graph that organizes policies, measurements, decisions, and alerts into a queryable explanation layer. Its foundational primitive is the Decision-Event node acting as a causal junction, where incoming edges capture triggering context and outgoing edges track downstream consequences that are progressively upgraded through counterfactual verification. item.title: 该论文提出去中心化原始平均算法DPA，通过本地准全局动量缓冲区在无需传输辅助跟踪变量的情况下构建网络感知的动量方向，有效应对高度异构数据下的去中心化训练难题，并建立了收敛界与随代理数量线性加速的条件。
item.description:
DPA：面向高度异构数据的具有准全局动量的去中心化原始平均算法

DPA: Decentralized Primal Averaging with Quasi-Global Momentum for Highly Heterogeneous Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16871

该论文提出去中心化原始平均算法DPA，通过本地准全局动量缓冲区在无需传输辅助跟踪变量的情况下构建网络感知的动量方向，有效应对高度异构数据下的去中心化训练难题，并建立了收敛界与随代理数量线性加速的条件。

深度学习模型的去中心化训练能够将训练数据保留在本地，并支持跨网络的设备端学习。在现实场景中，各代理本地数据之间的异构性带来了优化上的挑战，可能严重降低测试精度，尤其是在稀疏通信图上。基于集中式原始平均的最新进展，我们提出了去中心化原始平均，这是一种将原始平均与本地准全局动量缓冲区相结合的去中心化学习算法。DPA 维护三个相互耦合的序列，分别用于优化、梯度评估和输出平均，同时利用连续的混合迭代点构建具有网络感知能力的动量方向，而无需传输辅助跟踪变量。对于光滑非凸目标函数，我们为 DPA 建立了收敛界，并给出了在足够多的迭代次数下随代理数量实现线性加速的条件。我们还引入了……

arXiv:2611.16871v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Decentralized training of deep learning models keeps training data local and supports on-device learning over networks. In realistic scenarios, heterogeneity across agents' local data poses an optimization challenge and can severely degrade test accuracy, especially on sparse communication graphs. Building on recent advances in centralized primal averaging, we propose Decentralized Primal Averaging (DPA), a decentralized learning algorithm that combines primal averaging with a local quasi-global momentum buffer. DPA maintains three coupled sequences for optimization, gradient evaluation, and output averaging, while using consecutive mixed iterates to construct a network-aware momentum direction without transmitting an auxiliary tracking variable. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish a convergence bound for DPA and identify conditions for linear speedup in the number of agents for sufficiently many iterations. We also introduce

item.title: 该论文提出了ESGPred框架，通过结合领域特定的语言建模与基于公司关系网络的图学习方法，实现了对总体ESG评级及其环境、社会和治理各组成部分的模块化有效预测。
item.description:
基于领域特定语言建模与图学习的ESG预测模块化框架

A Modular Framework for ESG Prediction through Domain-Specific Language Modeling and Graph Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16831

该论文提出了ESGPred框架，通过结合领域特定的语言建模与基于公司关系网络的图学习方法，实现了对总体ESG评级及其环境、社会和治理各组成部分的模块化有效预测。

环境、社会和治理（ESG）评分日益被用于评估企业可持续性，以支持投资决策、确保监管合规和评估风险。然而，当前的ESG评估在很大程度上依赖于专有方法，这些方法往往产生不一致的评级，这促使了数据驱动预测框架的发展。在本文中，我们提出了ESGPred，这是一个用于预测ESG评分的模块化框架，它将领域特定的语言建模与基于图的学习相结合，在建模被评估公司之间关系的网络上进行学习。除了阐述ESGPred背后的设计理念并详细介绍其ESG评分预测过程外，我们还证明ESGPred能够有效预测总体ESG评级及其单独的环境、社会和治理组成部分。我们使用来自2,134家上市公司发布的5,266份可持续发展报告的数据集对ESGPred进行了评估。

arXiv:2611.16831v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) scores are increasingly used to evaluate corporate sustainability, supporting investment decisions, ensuring regulatory compliance and assessing risk. However, current ESG evaluations largely rely on proprietary methodologies that often produce inconsistent ratings. This motivates the development of data-driven prediction frameworks. In this paper, we present ESGPred, a modular framework for predicting ESG scores by combining domain-specific language modeling with graph-based learning over a network that models the relationships among the companies being evaluated. In addition to presenting the rationale behind ESGPred and detailing its ESG score prediction process, we show that ESGPred can effectively predict both overall ESG ratings and their individual Environmental, Social, and Governance components. item.title: 提出DashBench基准，利用1,709个涵盖碰撞及罕见非碰撞边缘案例的驾驶视频对25个视频大语言模型进行测试，揭示出这些模型在理解自动驾驶中安全关键的罕见场景方面存在显著的能力差距。
item.description:
评估视频大语言模型对自动驾驶中边缘案例的理解能力

Evaluating Video LLMs' Understanding of Corner Cases in Autonomous Driving

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16767

提出DashBench基准，利用1,709个涵盖碰撞及罕见非碰撞边缘案例的驾驶视频对25个视频大语言模型进行测试，揭示出这些模型在理解自动驾驶中安全关键的罕见场景方面存在显著的能力差距。

现代视频大语言模型所承诺的自然语言解释能力，为自动驾驶系统提供了一条实现详细场景描述和可解释道路决策的路径。尽管近期的基准测试已经开始在驾驶场景上评估这些模型，但它们主要针对常规交通状况以及基于现有驾驶数据集的一般性理解任务，因此无法评估模型在最罕见、最关乎安全的驾驶事件（即“边缘案例”）上的表现。为了对视频大语言模型在这些场景上的表现进行全面的评估，我们推出了DashBench，该基准在1,709个精心筛选的驾驶视频上测试了25个视频大语言模型，这些视频不仅涵盖与碰撞相关的边缘案例，还包括罕见的非碰撞边缘案例。通过大量的提示词和开放式问答，我们揭示了一个关键的能力差距：所有被评估的模型的表现都显著低于……（原文摘要至此截断）

arXiv:2611.16767v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Natural language explanations promised by modern Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) offer autonomous driving systems a path toward detailed scene description and interpretable decision making on the road. While recent benchmarks have begun assessing these models on driving scenes, they mainly target routine traffic conditions and general comprehension tasks based on existing driving datasets and therefore fail to evaluate model performance on the rarest and most safety-critical driving events, also known as "corner cases". item.title: 该论文提出AgriSense框架，将Isaac Sim虚拟温室、四足移动操作机器人与冻结的DINOv2/BERT视觉-语言编码器相结合，实现对环境参考值、目标区域和干预决策的联合预测，并诚实地报告了多模态融合在区域决策准确率上未见增量提升。

自主温室管理日益需要集感知、导航、环境调节和植物级干预于一体的机器人系统。本文提出AgriSense，一个结合Isaac Sim虚拟温室、四足移动操作机器人、RGB与激光雷达-惯性传感、环境控制以及监督式视觉-语言决策支持的框架。冻结的DINOv2和BERT编码器结合结构化环境输入，支持对十二个环境参考值、一个目标区域和一个干预标志的联合预测。检查点回放复现了41/43的区域决策。在源分组测试集上跨五个随机种子，完整配置、去除图像配置和去除语言配置均达到43/44的正确区域决策，未提供多模态融合在区域准确率上带来增量提升的证据。完整模型在温度上取得0.249摄氏度的平均绝对误差，2.030个百分点的（摘要在此处被截断）

Checkpoint replay reproduces 41/43 zone decisions. Across five seeds on a source-grouped test set, the full, image-removed, and language-removed configurations each achieve 43/44 correct zone decisions, providing no evidence of incremental multimodal zone-accuracy improvement. item.title: ORCA通过提取跨视图正交残差的语义增量循环融合模块和基于全局共识校准的分层对比对齐模块，解决了多视图聚类中的冗余信息积累与表示层级无差别对齐问题，在五个基准数据集上取得显著性能提升。
item.description:
ORCA：面向多视图聚类的正交残差共识对齐方法

ORCA:Orthogonal Residual Consensus Alignment for Multi-View Clustering

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16749

ORCA通过提取跨视图正交残差的语义增量循环融合模块和基于全局共识校准的分层对比对齐模块，解决了多视图聚类中的冗余信息积累与表示层级无差别对齐问题，在五个基准数据集上取得显著性能提升。

深度多视图聚类在融合过程中常常面临冗余信息积累的问题，并且在表示层级之间进行不加区分的对齐。我们提出正交残差共识对齐（ORCA）方法来应对这些挑战。其语义增量循环融合模块提取跨视图正交残差作为非冗余增量，并通过散度引导的门控机制自适应地对循环状态进行加权。其共识校准的分层对比对齐模块利用全局共识对视图级、成对以及循环表示的对比对齐进行加权。两个模块协同工作，在视图特定结构与跨视图一致性之间取得平衡。在五个基准数据集上与十五种竞争方法的对比实验证明了ORCA的有效性，其中包括在100leaves数据集上相比最强基线准确率提升了5.25%。消融实验验证了两个模块的有效性。代码已开源于（链接被截断）。

arXiv:2611.16749v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep multi-view clustering often suffers from redundant information accumulation during fusion and indiscriminate alignment across representation levels. We propose Orthogonal Residual Consensus Alignment (ORCA) to address these challenges. Its semantic incremental recurrent fusion module extracts cross-view orthogonal residuals as non-redundant increments and adaptively weights recurrent states through divergence-guided gating. Its consensus-calibrated hierarchical contrastive alignment module uses the global consensus to weight contrastive alignment of view-level, pairwise, and recurrent representations. Together, these modules balance view-specific structure with cross-view consistency. Experiments on five benchmarks against fifteen competing methods demonstrate ORCA's effectiveness, including a 5.25 percent accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on 100leaves. Ablation studies validate both modules. Code is available at ht

item.title: PhysLoop提出了一个统一框架，通过在视频生成、选择和修正的全过程中引导并约束大语言模型，将其物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频数据，从而实现视频生成模型基于物理的自我改进与递归自我提升。
item.description:
PhysLoop：利用大语言模型的物理感知能力实现视频生成模型的自我改进

PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16748

PhysLoop提出了一个统一框架，通过在视频生成、选择和修正的全过程中引导并约束大语言模型，将其物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频数据，从而实现视频生成模型基于物理的自我改进与递归自我提升。

视频生成模型能够生成视觉上逼真的视频，但在物理动态和因果一致性方面仍存在不足。从生成的视频中学习需要细粒度的物理监督，然而可靠的质量判断、修正配对以及可控的变化都难以获得。大语言模型（LLM）虽然拥有物理知识，但难以可靠地引导视频生成模型生成其训练所需的视频。我们提出了PhysLoop，一个旨在支持视频生成模型基于物理的自我改进的统一框架。该框架在视频生成、选择和修正的全过程中引导并约束大语言模型，将其物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频。该框架支持可控的训练数据构建以及推理阶段的视频修复。通过识别和纠正失败，PhysLoop标志着视频生成模型向递归自我改进（RSI）迈出了关键里程碑。

arXiv:2611.16748v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain. Large language models (LLMs) possess physical knowledge, but struggle to reliably guide video generation models in producing their training videos. We present PhysLoop, a unified harness designed to support physically grounded self-improvement in video generation models. The harness guides and constrains LLMs throughout video generation, selection, and correction, distilling their physical knowledge into physically consistent videos. The framework supports controllable training-data construction and inference-time video repair. 该论文揭示了一种新型安全威胁“尺度诱导语义偏移”（SISS）：图像经过激进压缩下采样后，原本无法被识别的提示注入指令反而变得可被视觉语言模型读取，并提出了结合双尺度验证、选择性自我强化与低秩适配的闭环黑盒攻击框架，在四个闭源模型上实现了58.75%的攻击成功率。

多媒体系统中的视觉内容在视觉语言模型进行解读之前，可能会经历缩放、压缩或重新渲染等处理。我们研究了一种安全失效模式：这些变换会改变图像的机器可读语义——在我们的评估协议下，一条文本指令在512×512的呈现分辨率下无法被识别出来，但在激进下采样之后却变得可以被识别。我们将这种行为形式化为“尺度诱导语义偏移”，并开发了一个闭环黑盒框架，该框架结合了双尺度验证、选择性自我强化、浅层低秩适配以及像素空间噪声正则化。在一个固定的300个案例基准上，第三轮SISS迭代优化在四个闭源视觉语言模型上取得了58.75%的平均攻击成功率，相比之下最强的生成式基线仅为41.08%。一项受控扫描实验将这一效应的范围限定于激进压缩的情形。

item.title: EgoX提出了一种第一人称视角的跨具身学习框架，通过为每个观测和动作模态配置专用分词器与专家模块、共享Transformer主干，并借助仅在训练阶段使用的“具身梦境”未来状态预测目标，使通用操作策略能够有效利用人类、真实机器人和仿真智能体的异构演示数据。

从基础视觉语言模型到多功能驾驶视觉语言模型：一种三元组增量训练方法

该论文提出非侵入式的三元组增量训练框架，利用自动构建的（图像、深度、问答）三元组为通用VLM注入3D几何感知，发现精确度量深度是现成VLM适配驾驶任务的关键缺失环节，从而在保留开放世界能力的同时将其转化为多功能自动驾驶模型。

将通用视觉语言模型（VLM）适配到自动驾驶（AD）领域，通常被认为需要大量的3D空间先验或侵入式的架构改造，以弥补其空间定位能力的不足。在这项工作中，我们展示了一项反直觉的初步研究：现成的通用VLM在多种驾驶任务中已展现出卓越的适应性，而精确的度量深度才是主要的缺失环节——这一瓶颈可以通过车载传感器和深度基础模型轻松解决。为此，我们提出了三元组增量训练框架，这是一种非侵入式范式，可将3D几何感知无缝注入通用VLM骨干网络，同时完整保留其开放世界能力。在自动构建的（图像、深度、问答对）三元组的驱动下，我们的框架通过统一的三流训练流水线运作：一个未冻结的主VLM流用于适配驾驶任务，一个辅助深度流用于……

arXiv:2611.16727v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Adapting general Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to Autonomous Driving (AD) is thought to require heavy 3D spatial priors or intrusive architectural overhauls to compensate for a lack of spatial grounding. In this work, we present a counterintuitive pilot study: off-the-shelf general VLMs already exhibit remarkable adaptability across diverse driving tasks, while precise metric depth remains the primary missing link, a bottleneck readily addressable via onboard sensors and depth foundation models. From Data to Wisdom: Rethinking AI Through an Epistemic Lens

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16726

本文提出数据到智慧的人工智能认识论架构（EAAI），将数据、信息、知识、理解与智慧视为五种递归相互作用的认识功能，并以贝叶斯推断为例说明如何用该框架统一解释AI系统中的观察、解释、预测、评估与判断。

本文提出了“数据到智慧的人工智能认识论架构”（EAAI），这是一个概念框架，将数据、信息、知识、理解和智慧视为五种既相互独立又递归相互作用的认识功能：观察、情境解释、建模与预测、批判性评估以及知情判断。该框架的提出基于两点观察：一是对知识金字塔的顺序式解读掩盖了这些功能之间实际的相互作用方式；二是对十本贝叶斯参考书的有针对性综述发现，先验分布在数学上有明确定义，但“先验信息”和“先验知识”并未作为认识论范畴得到一致区分。本文通过贝叶斯解释将似然、先验和后验分布、后验预测、模型检验和决策分析与这五种功能联系起来，同时并不将EAAI局限于贝叶斯系统。在认识论意义上扩展“先验”概念，本文区分了五（摘要原文在此处截断）

item.title: 本文结合基准测试与两项大规模用户研究，量化了不同人格设定下LLM的谄媚程度，并揭示了谄媚型AI在日常任务中存在的“准确性-认可度差距”。
item.description:
注意准确性-认可度差距：用户如何在日常任务中评价谄媚型AI

Mind the Accuracy-Approval Gap: How Users Evaluate Sycophantic AI in Everyday Tasks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16722

本文结合基准测试与两项大规模用户研究，量化了不同人格设定下LLM的谄媚程度，并揭示了谄媚型AI在日常任务中存在的“准确性-认可度差距”。

大型语言模型（LLMs）经常表现出谄媚性（sycophancy），即倾向于同意用户、奉承或肯定用户，并维护用户的面子，即使独立判断或批评性反馈会更有用。以往的工作主要通过基准测试来评估谄媚性，但对用户在日常任务中如何感知和回应谄媚型AI的了解较少。我们结合基准测试与两项大规模用户研究开展研究。我们研究了通过系统提示词定义的四种人格设定：客观型（被指示优先考虑准确性而非附和）、轻度谄媚型、重度谄媚型和基线型（无人格特定的系统提示词）。基准测试显示，即使是基线型也表现出明显的谄媚性，在NLP Survey上71.7%的情况下同意用户表达的观点，相比之下客观型为54.8%，重度谄媚型为89.5%。在TruthfulQA的对话压力下，准确率从客观型的81.9%到基线型的59.6%不等。

Prior work has largely evaluated sycophancy through benchmark evaluations, but less is known about how users perceive and respond to sycophantic AI in everyday tasks. We combine benchmark evaluations with two large-scale user studies. We study four personas defined through system prompts: objective (instructed to prioritize accuracy over agreement), soft-sycophantic, hard-sycophantic, and baseline (no persona-specific system prompt). Benchmarks show that even baseline exhibits substantial sycophancy, agreeing with users' stated views 71.7% of the time on NLP Survey, compared with 54.8% for objective and 89.5% for hard-sycophantic. 提出了基于RWKV架构的多模态音乐表征学习框架MusicRWKV，以线性复杂度联合建模波形、频谱和元数据，并通过可逆压缩模块与FiLM条件化策略高效处理长音乐序列。

近期音乐基础模型在音乐表征学习方面取得了显著进展，然而大多数现有方法依赖于Transformer架构，其二次方注意力复杂度在对长时间音乐录音进行建模时会带来巨大的计算与内存开销。在本工作中，我们提出了MusicRWKV，一个基于RWKV架构构建的多模态音乐表征学习框架。MusicRWKV在统一的自监督学习框架内联合建模波形、频谱图和元数据信息。为提高长音乐序列的处理效率，我们引入了一个可逆压缩模块，在保持重建能力的同时缩短序列长度。我们采用基于FiLM的条件化策略来促进模态感知的表征学习，而无需引入昂贵的交叉注意力操作。我们进一步研究了将Soft ROSA作为一种可微分（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.16718v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent music foundation models have achieved remarkable progress in music representation learning, yet most existing approaches rely on Transformer architectures whose quadratic attention complexity introduces substantial computational and memory overhead when modeling long-duration music recordings. In this work, we propose MusicRWKV, a multimodal music representation learning framework built upon the RWKV architecture. MusicRWKV jointly models waveform, spectrogram, and metadata information within a unified self-supervised learning framework. To improve efficiency for long musical sequences, we introduce an invertible compression module that reduces sequence length while preserving reconstruction capability. A FiLM-based conditioning strategy is employed to facilitate modality-aware representation learning without introducing expensive cross-attention operations. item.title: 本文提出了一种基于智能手机声学信号的无创呼吸相位检测框架，采用混合CNN-Transformer架构捕捉呼吸周期结构，在留一被试评估中实现72.85%的帧级准确率和96.6%的周期级呼气检测效率。
item.description:
移动设备上的声学呼吸相位检测

Acoustic Respiratory Phase Detection on Mobile Devices

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16710

本文提出了一种基于智能手机声学信号的无创呼吸相位检测框架，采用混合CNN-Transformer架构捕捉呼吸周期结构，在留一被试评估中实现72.85%的帧级准确率和96.6%的周期级呼气检测效率。

呼吸监测对于健康、压力调节和引导式呼吸练习非常重要，但现有方法通常依赖于接触式传感器或受控环境。本文提出了一种基于普通智能手机录制的声学信号进行呼吸相位检测的无创框架。所提出的混合CNN-Transformer架构将局部频谱特征提取与长程时间建模相结合，以捕捉呼吸的周期性结构。该模型在Foundation Dataset上采用留一被试（LOSO）协议进行评估，并在一个包含超过1300个呼吸周期和2小时连续录音的独立未见测试集上进行验证。所提出的三分类方案在LOSO评估中实现了72.85%的帧级准确率和96.6%的周期级呼气检测效率，同时在未见测试集上实现了76.94%的帧级准确率、0.65的Cohen's Kappa系数以及99.2%的周期级呼气检测效率。

arXiv:2611.16710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Breathing monitoring is important for well-being, stress regulation, and guided breathing exercises, yet existing approaches often rely on contact-based sensors or controlled environments. This paper presents a non-invasive framework for respiratory phase detection using acoustic signals recorded on commodity smartphones. The proposed hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture combines local spectral feature extraction with long-range temporal modeling to capture the cyclic structure of breathing. The model is evaluated using a Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) protocol on the Foundation Dataset and on an independent unseen test set comprising over 1300 breathing cycles and 2 hours of continuous recordings. The proposed 3-class formulation achieves 72.85% frame-level accuracy and 96.6% cycle-level exhalation detection efficiency in the LOSO evaluation, while achieving 76.94% frame-level accuracy, a Cohen's Kappa score of 0.65, and 99.2% cycle-level

item.title: 该论文提出受控两轮审计方法，揭示大语言模型面对（尤其是专家署名的）异议时修订决策的“选择性”不足——逆转正确答案过于频繁，五个模型无一达到理论所需的修订选择性标准，准确率最多下降16.1个百分点。
item.description:
当专家异议造成伤害时：大语言模型决策修订中的权威效应与选择性

When Expert Disagreement Hurts: Prestige and Selectivity in LLM Decision Revision

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16694

该论文提出受控两轮审计方法，揭示大语言模型面对（尤其是专家署名的）异议时修订决策的“选择性”不足——逆转正确答案过于频繁，五个模型无一达到理论所需的修订选择性标准，准确率最多下降16.1个百分点。

当语言模型在另一个智能体提出异议后修订决策时，无论是逆转次数还是最终准确率，都无法显示它们是在纠正错误还是在放弃正确答案。我们引入了一种受控的两轮审计方法：固定问题、证据和模型的初始答案不变，仅改变修订情境——中性反思、匿名异议，或归因于领域专家的异议。对于二元决策，这一核算方法是精确的：只有当修订足够具有选择性时才能提高准确率，即逆转错误答案的频率必须至少是逆转正确答案频率的 $a/(1-a)$ 倍，其中 $a$ 为初始准确率（当准确率为90%时需达到九倍）。在五个模型、共1,989个基于证据的医学、科学和法律决策中，没有任何模型在专家异议下达到这一标准，准确率下降幅度高达16.1个百分点。专家标签作为一种权威线索，在五个模型中的四个上增加了逆转次数，但其对准确率的影响范围……

arXiv:2611.16694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When language models revise a decision after another agent disagrees, neither reversal counts nor final accuracy shows whether they are fixing mistakes or abandoning correct answers. We introduce a controlled two-pass audit that holds the question, the evidence, and the model's initial answer fixed and varies only the revision context: neutral reflection, anonymous disagreement, or disagreement attributed to a domain expert. For binary decisions the accounting is exact: revision raises accuracy only if it is selective enough, reversing wrong answers more than $a/(1-a)$ times as often as correct ones, where $a$ is initial accuracy (nine times at 90%). Across five models and 1,989 evidence-grounded decisions in medicine, science, and law, no model clears this bar under expert disagreement, and accuracy falls by up to 16.1 points. item.title: 本文提出MobileProbe，一种基于轨迹感知的自适应安全评估方法，通过根据移动智能体的实际执行轨迹动态注入环境攻击载荷，解决了现有定点基准测试中攻击载荷难以迁移、测试覆盖不足从而低估安全风险的问题。
item.description:
MobileProbe：基于轨迹感知注入的移动智能体自适应安全评估

MobileProbe: Adaptive Security Evaluation of Mobile Agents via Trajectory-Aware Injection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16693

本文提出MobileProbe，一种基于轨迹感知的自适应安全评估方法，通过根据移动智能体的实际执行轨迹动态注入环境攻击载荷，解决了现有定点基准测试中攻击载荷难以迁移、测试覆盖不足从而低估安全风险的问题。

移动GUI智能体通过读取手机屏幕内容并代表用户操作应用，来完成诸如在线购物或发送消息等多步骤任务。由于智能体会对屏幕上显示的任何内容采取行动，攻击者可以将恶意指令嵌入普通UI内容中并劫持其行为，我们将这种威胁称为环境注入攻击（EIA）。现有基准测试通过将手工制作的攻击载荷固定在特定任务的特定步骤上来衡量这种风险，该方法存在两个局限：首先，每个攻击载荷绑定于单一应用中的单个任务，若不进行人工重新设计则无法迁移；其次，执行相同任务的智能体可能采取不同路径，因此从未到达被注入页面的智能体会在未经实际测试的情况下被记录为安全。这种测试覆盖不足可能导致定点基准测试低估已部署移动智能体的安全风险。在本工作中，我们提出了MobileProbe，一种轨迹感知的红队……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.16693v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mobile GUI agents read the screen of a phone and operate apps on a user's behalf to complete multi-step tasks such as online shopping or messaging. Because the agent acts on whatever the screen shows, an attacker can embed malicious instructions into ordinary UI content and redirect its actions. We refer to this threat as environmental injection attack (EIA). Existing benchmarks measure this risk by pinning hand-crafted payloads to a fixed step of a fixed task. This approach faces two limitations. First, each payload is bound to one task in one app and does not transfer without manual redesign. Second, agents given the same task may follow different routes, so an agent that never reaches the injected page is recorded as safe without being tested. item.title: 本文提出EG-RL框架，利用强化学习机制动态选择并增强时序图中信息量最大的边梯度事件（边的出现与消失），从而显著提升时序链路预测的准确率。
item.description:
基于强化学习的时序图边梯度增强

Edge-Gradient Augmentation under Reinforcement Learning for Temporal Graph

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16678

本文提出EG-RL框架，利用强化学习机制动态选择并增强时序图中信息量最大的边梯度事件（边的出现与消失），从而显著提升时序链路预测的准确率。

时序链路预测对于理解演化网络中的动态交互至关重要，为从社交网络分析到推荐系统等诸多应用提供支持。现有方法通常依赖于原始时序图数据，往往忽略了能够显著提升预测性能的显式边变化信息。为弥补这一不足，我们提出边梯度强化学习框架（EG-RL），该框架通过专门的节点编码和链路编码模块，显式地编码边梯度事件（即边的出现与消失）。EG-RL采用策略驱动的强化学习机制，在基于评论家反馈的引导下，动态选择并增强信息量最大的边快照，以优化预测精度。该模型由节点编码、链路编码、令牌混合和通道混合等独立模块组成，通过全局池化进行整合，其后接一个两层多层感知机。

arXiv:2611.16678v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Temporal link prediction is critical for understand- ing dynamic interactions in evolving networks, informing appli- cations ranging from social network analysis to recommendation systems. Existing methods typically rely on raw temporal graph data, often neglecting explicit edge-change information that can significantly improve predictive performance. To address this gap, we propose edge-gradient reinforced learning (EG-RL), a framework that explicitly encodes edge-gradient events (edge births and deaths) through dedicated node and link encoding modules. EG-RL uses a policy-driven reinforcement-learning mechanism to dynamically select and augment the most infor- mative edge snapshots, guided by critic-based feedback to opti- mize prediction accuracy. The model comprises distinct modules for node encoding, link encoding, token mixing, and channel mixing, integrated through global pooling and followed by a two-layer multilayer perceptron

item.title: 该论文提出Natural PC，通过引入侧向回路学习决定Fisher信息矩阵的活动相关性并隐式计算其逆，使预测编码在空间和时间局部范围内实现精确高效的自然梯度学习，在图像重建基准中达到样本与计算效率的最先进水平。
item.description:
通过侧向回路实现预测编码中的自然梯度学习

Natural Gradient Learning in Predictive Coding through Lateral Circuits

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16666

该论文提出Natural PC，通过引入侧向回路学习决定Fisher信息矩阵的活动相关性并隐式计算其逆，使预测编码在空间和时间局部范围内实现精确高效的自然梯度学习，在图像重建基准中达到样本与计算效率的最先进水平。

预测编码通过局部能量最小化动力学来训练神经网络，无需依赖反向传播所必需的全局误差信号。尽管预测编码是一种有前景的高效学习替代算法，但在实践中，推理动力学的计算成本目前超过了其带来的学习收益。在这项工作中，我们从优化理论中汲取灵感，以便从每个推理阶段中获取更多的学习收益。我们提出了Natural PC，它通过一个侧向回路来增强标准的预测编码，从而在空间和时间上实现精确且高效的局部自然梯度学习。我们的侧向回路学习决定Fisher信息矩阵的活动相关性，并隐式地计算其逆矩阵，从而避免了昂贵的矩阵求逆操作。在所有测试的图像重建基准任务中，与现有方法相比，Natural PC在样本效率和计算效率方面均达到了最先进的水平。

arXiv:2611.16666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predictive coding (PC) trains neural networks through local energy-minimization dynamics without depending on a global error signal that backpropagation (BP) requires. Although PC is a promising alternative algorithm for efficient learning, the computational cost of inference dynamics currently outweighs the resulting learning benefits in practice. In this work, we take inspiration from optimization theory to extract more learning benefit from each inference phase. We introduce Natural PC, which augments standard PC with a lateral circuit, enabling exact and efficient natural gradient learning locally in space and time. Our lateral circuit learns the activity correlations that determine the Fisher information matrix and implicitly computes its inverse, avoiding expensive matrix inversion. Across all tested image reconstruction benchmarks, Natural PC achieves state of the art in terms of sample and compute efficiency compared to existing

item.title: 该论文提出了经过人类验证的MuSeToM基准，通过涵盖六种感官类别的文本线索，首次系统评估大型语言模型能否判断感知证据何时足以触发心理理论中的信念修正，并推断出更新后的信念状态。
item.description:
MuSeToM：基于六种感官文本线索的信念修正多感官评估

MuSeToM: Multi-Sensory Evaluation of Belief Revision with Textual Cues Across Six Senses

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16662

该论文提出了经过人类验证的MuSeToM基准，通过涵盖六种感官类别的文本线索，首次系统评估大型语言模型能否判断感知证据何时足以触发心理理论中的信念修正，并推断出更新后的信念状态。

心理理论，即推断他人心理状态的能力，是人类社会认知的关键。现有对大型语言模型心理理论能力的评估主要集中于静态信念归属和错误信念推理，而社会推理中一个关键方面尚未得到充分探索：大型语言模型能否判断感知证据是否足以支持另一个人修正其信念？为填补这一空白，我们提出了MuSeToM——一个经过人类验证的、基于文本的基准，用于评估心理理论推理中的认知性信念修正。MuSeToM包含2,415个改编自BigToM和OpenToM的实例，其文本线索涵盖六种感官类别，测试模型能否判断主人公何时应当修正信念，并推断出更新后的信念状态。利用MuSeToM，我们在直接提示和思维链提示下系统评估了最先进的大型语言模型，揭示出一种显著的不协调现象：尽管模型往往……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.16662v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer mental states in others, is pivotal for human social cognition. Existing evaluations of ToM in large language models (LLMs) mainly focus on static belief attribution and false-belief reasoning, leaving a critical aspect of social reasoning underexplored: can LLMs decide whether perceptual evidence is sufficient to justify another person's belief revision? To address this gap, we present MuSeToM, a human-validated, text-based benchmark for evaluating epistemic belief revision in ToM reasoning. MuSeToM contains 2,415 instances adapted from BigToM and OpenToM, with textual cues spanning six sensory categories, and tests whether models can determine when a protagonist should revise a belief and infer the resulting updated belief state. item.title: 该论文提出推理与环境协调的优化方案——包括基于工作负载的GPU显存分配模型、轨迹感知路由调度以及优先推进长链条的链推进动作调度（CAAS）——显著减少了LLM智能体批量任务的总完成时间。
item.description:
通过推理与环境协调减少LLM智能体工作负载的批量完成时间

Reducing Batch Makespan for LLM Agent Workloads through Inference-Environment Coordination

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16661

该论文提出推理与环境协调的优化方案——包括基于工作负载的GPU显存分配模型、轨迹感知路由调度以及优先推进长链条的链推进动作调度（CAAS）——显著减少了LLM智能体批量任务的总完成时间。

智能体任务的高效批量执行对LLM训练和开发工作流至关重要，包括基准评估、合成数据生成和强化学习rollout。由于这些任务在LLM推理与环境交互之间交替进行，我们提出了协调优化方法来减少批量完成时间，即完成一批中所有任务所需的时间。对于混合LLM，基于工作负载的资源模型指导GPU显存在键值缓存（KV cache）与循环状态之间的分配，并提供参考样本并发度，在限制重计算的同时充分利用并行性。轨迹感知的路由与调度在平衡工作节点负载的同时促进缓存复用。在环境容量受限的情况下，我们将样本准入与环境执行解耦，并引入链推进动作调度（CAAS），该方法利用观察到的进展优先调度长链条，从而缩短批量的尾部延迟。受控回放结合了实际推理（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.16661v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Efficient batch execution of agent tasks is critical to LLM training and development workflows, including benchmark evaluation, synthetic-data generation, and RL rollouts. Since these tasks alternate between LLM inference and environment interaction, we present coordinated optimizations to reduce batch makespan, the time required to complete all tasks in a batch. For hybrid LLMs, a workload-based resource model guides GPU-memory allocation between key-value (KV) cache and recurrent state and provides a reference sample concurrency to exploit parallelism while limiting recomputation. Trajectory-aware routing and scheduling promote cache reuse while balancing worker load. Under constrained environment capacity, we decouple sample admission from environment execution and introduce Chain-Advancing Action Scheduling (CAAS), which prioritizes long chains using observed progress to shorten the batch tail. Controlled replay combines actual inf

item.title: 受情绪惯性概念启发，该论文提出InertiaMPDD方法，通过世界模型式潜在预测器学习健康情绪状态转移模式，并以参照偏离、残差衰减率和雅可比谱描述符等情绪动力学描述符作为代理生物标志物，实现多模态个性化抑郁症检测，在多个数据集上取得优异性能。
item.description:
InertiaMPDD：基于情绪惯性启发的动态建模的多模态个性化抑郁症检测

InertiaMPDD: Multimodal Personalized Depression Detection via Emotional Inertia-Inspired Dynamics Modeling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16647

受情绪惯性概念启发，该论文提出InertiaMPDD方法，通过世界模型式潜在预测器学习健康情绪状态转移模式，并以参照偏离、残差衰减率和雅可比谱描述符等情绪动力学描述符作为代理生物标志物，实现多模态个性化抑郁症检测，在多个数据集上取得优异性能。

多模态抑郁症筛查通过语音、视觉行为和语言来估计风险。现有方法主要局限于预测标签，缺乏相对于非抑郁参照状态发生偏离的证据。此外，录音级别的监督方式也使得细粒度的情绪动态未被标注。受情绪惯性（即情感的持续性）启发，InertiaMPDD使用受世界模型启发的潜在预测器来学习健康的下一状态模式。该方法利用预训练的多模态表示，从观测历史和上下文信息中进行预测。参照偏离、残差衰减率和雅可比谱描述符构成了基于参照衍生的情绪动力学描述符，这些描述符被评估为用于独立筛查和个性化决策校正的候选代理生物标志物。在来自四个数据集的五个队列上，融合方法在D-Vlog上达到98.41%的F1分数，在LMVD上达到84.98%。独立的描述符在MPDD上优于固定加性融合方法，但在AVEC上判别能力较弱。

arXiv:2611.16647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal depression screening estimates risk from speech, visual behavior and language. Current methods mainly predict labels, with limited evidence of departures from a non-depressed reference. Recording-level supervision also leaves fine-grained emotional dynamics unannotated. Motivated by emotional inertia, the persistence of affect, InertiaMPDD learns healthy next-state patterns using a world-model-inspired latent predictor. Using pretrained multimodal representations, it predicts from observed history and context. Reference deviation, residual decay rate and a Jacobian spectral descriptor form reference-derived emotional dynamics descriptors, evaluated as candidate proxy biomarkers for standalone screening and personalized decision correction. Across five cohorts from four datasets, fusion reaches 98.41% F1 on D-Vlog and 84.98% on LMVD. Standalone descriptors outperform fixed additive fusion on MPDD but discriminate weakly on AVEC

item.title: 该论文提出了一种无需分类目标的数据集蒸馏新方法，通过在特征提取器潜空间中使蒸馏样本向真实数据“漂移”并彼此远离，从而直接逼近各类数据分布，显著提升对真实分布的覆盖效果。
item.description:
基于漂移的数据集蒸馏

Dataset Distillation via Drifting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16642

该论文提出了一种无需分类目标的数据集蒸馏新方法，通过在特征提取器潜空间中使蒸馏样本向真实数据“漂移”并彼此远离，从而直接逼近各类数据分布，显著提升对真实分布的覆盖效果。

数据集蒸馏的任务是学习一小组合成样本，这些样本在用于下游任务时能够有效替代大型真实数据集。虽然自该问题提出以来已有许多解决方案，但其中大多数主要寻求针对分类器来优化蒸馏数据。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的蒸馏方法，它学习一组样本，使其直接逼近每类的数据分布。具体而言，我们在特征提取器的潜空间中对蒸馏数据进行“漂移”，使其既向真实数据靠近，又彼此远离，而无需使用分类目标。我们发现，我们的漂移数据比现有方法显著更好地覆盖真实分布，同时仍可作为强大的分类训练样本。此外，我们还展示了该方法作为一种可视化工具的用途，以便更好地（摘要至此截断）……

arXiv:2611.16642v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The task of dataset distillation concerns the learning of a small set of synthetic samples that can serve as an effective replacement for a large real dataset when used for downstream tasks. While many solutions have been proposed since the problem's inception, most of them primarily seek to optimize the distilled data with respect to a classifier. In this work, we propose a new distillation method that learns a set of samples such that they directly approximate the per-class data distribution. Specifically, we "drift" our distilled data in the latent space of a feature extractor such that they move both toward the real data and away from each other without using a classification objective. We find that our drifted data cover the real distribution significantly better than existing methods while still serving as powerful training samples for classification. Furthermore, we showcase our method's use as a visualization tool for better in

item.title: 本文提出 OverReal 基准（覆盖否定、心理状态、比喻、视角遮挡四类语境的 698 条提示词及 2,841 张人工标注图像），首次系统测量文生图模型中提示词未要求出现的目标仍被生成的“过度实现”失败，发现全部八个受测系统均存在该问题，而现有对齐与偏好指标无法检测到它。
item.description:
当“契诃夫之枪”依然开火：文生图模型中的过度实现现象

When Chekhov's Gun Fires Anyway: Over-Realization in Text-to-Image Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16630

本文提出 OverReal 基准（覆盖否定、心理状态、比喻、视角遮挡四类语境的 698 条提示词及 2,841 张人工标注图像），首次系统测量文生图模型中提示词未要求出现的目标仍被生成的“过度实现”失败，发现全部八个受测系统均存在该问题，而现有对齐与偏好指标无法检测到它。

在文本到图像生成中，提示词所提及的目标常常以提示词并未要求的方式出现在生成的图像中。我们将这种失败称为“过度实现”。心理空间理论指出了这类情况可能发生的场景：在否定句中、在角色所相信或想象的内容之中、作为比喻性比较的喻体，或在遮挡目标的视角之下。先前的工作仅深入研究过否定这一种情形，而常规的对齐与偏好类指标并不会惩罚这种失败。我们构建了 OverReal 来测量它：OverReal-Gen 包含覆盖上述四种情形的 698 条提示词，用于测量每个生成器的过度实现率；OverReal-Det 包含 2,841 张经人工标注“目标是否以及如何被过度实现”的生成图像，用于验证产生该比率的自动裁判。我们对八个文生图系统的评估显示，它们全部存在过度实现现象，且常规的……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.16630v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In text-to-image generation, a target that the prompt mentions often appears in the generated image in a way the prompt does not call for. We call this failure over-realization. Mental-spaces theory points to the situations where it can happen: under a negation, inside what a character believes or imagines, as the vehicle of a figurative comparison, or behind a viewpoint that hides the target. Prior work has studied only negation in depth, and the conventional alignment and preference metrics do not penalize the failure. We build OverReal to measure it: OverReal-Gen, 698 prompts covering the four situations, on which we measure each generator's over-realization rate; and OverReal-Det, 2,841 generated images human-labeled for whether and how the target is over-realized, on which we verify the automatic judge that produces this rate. Our evaluation of eight text-to-image systems reveals that all of them over-realize, and that conventiona

item.title: 该论文提出双通道约束GRPO方法，将安全性建模为显式预算约束并校准其控制通道，从而修复了标准GRPO中组内奖励标准化会抵消拉格朗日乘子、以及排序型评分器的均值偏差会破坏约束控制的两大失败模式。
item.description:
安全作为预算：为视觉语言模型校准约束GRPO的控制通道

Safety as a Budget: Calibrating the Control Channel of Constrained GRPO for Vision-Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16628

该论文提出双通道约束GRPO方法，将安全性建模为显式预算约束并校准其控制通道，从而修复了标准GRPO中组内奖励标准化会抵消拉格朗日乘子、以及排序型评分器的均值偏差会破坏约束控制的两大失败模式。

强化学习可以教会视觉语言模型（VLM）拒绝有害的图文请求，但最终的安全程度是间接设定的——依赖反复试运行找到的奖励权重。将安全性表述为对有害协助率和过度拒绝率的预算约束，在GRPO内部通过拉格朗日乘子强制执行，并以现成的评分器作为代价信号，看似是自然而然的解决方案，但它会在两个方面失败。其一，乘子将评分器的均值与预算进行比较，而为排序任务设计的评分器会算错均值：不动点分析表明，此时是均值偏差而非预算本身决定乘子最终是收敛、饱和还是被关闭。其二，标准GRPO会在每个组内对带惩罚的奖励进行标准化，这在乘子传导到梯度之前就将其抵消了。双通道约束GRPO同时修复了这两个问题：基础奖励通道保留原始分数用于组内比较，而惩罚信号与约束估计则通过……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.16628v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning can teach vision-language models (VLMs) to decline harmful image-text requests, but how safe the result becomes is set indirectly, through reward weights found by trial runs. Stating safety as budgets on the rate of harmful assistance and the rate of over-refusal, enforced by Lagrange multipliers inside GRPO with an off-the-shelf scorer as the cost, is the natural fix, and it fails twice. The multiplier compares the scorer's mean with the budget, and scorers built for ranking get the mean wrong: a fixed-point analysis shows that the mean bias, not the budget, then decides whether the multiplier settles, saturates or switches off. And standard GRPO standardizes the penalized reward within each group, which cancels the multiplier before it reaches the gradient. item.title: Folio提出了一种可恢复的多分辨率上下文折叠机制，通过回合笔记、事件清单和源记录三个层级以编程方式折叠长程语言代理的历史上下文，并允许通过句柄恢复被折叠的信息，避免了传统摘要压缩方式反复重读和重写历史的开销。
item.description:
Folio：面向长程语言代理的可恢复多分辨率上下文折叠

Folio: Recoverable Multi-Resolution Context Folding for Long-Horizon Language Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16627

Folio提出了一种可恢复的多分辨率上下文折叠机制，通过回合笔记、事件清单和源记录三个层级以编程方式折叠长程语言代理的历史上下文，并允许通过句柄恢复被折叠的信息，避免了传统摘要压缩方式反复重读和重写历史的开销。

长程语言代理会不断累积工具结果与回复，直到历史记录超出上下文窗口的容量。当前的代理通过让模型对历史进行摘要来缩减历史，因此每次压缩都需要重新读取并重写它所替代的历史，而缓存感知的触发器在决定何时压缩时则将结果的大小视为给定条件。我们提出了Folio，一个通过一组句柄来记录、折叠和恢复历史的上下文管理器。在代理运行时，Folio记录三个相互关联的层级：模型作为普通回复一部分写下的简短回合笔记（L1）、由运行时写入的记录每次调用的事件清单（L2），以及被捕获的源记录（L3）。由于这些视图已经存在，运行时能够以编程方式折叠上下文，为较旧的回合选择更粗粒度的视图。折叠操作会打印索引L2和L3的句柄，使得恢复工具可以读取有界的页面、对文件中的全文进行计算，并将发现保存（原文在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2611.16627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon language agents accumulate tool results and replies until the history no longer fits the context window. Current agents shrink this history by having a model summarize it, so each compaction rereads and rewrites the history it replaces, and cache-aware triggers decide when to compact while taking the size of the result as given. We present Folio, a context manager that records, folds, and recovers history through one set of handles. While the agent runs, Folio records three linked levels: a short turn note the model writes as part of its ordinary reply (L1), an event manifest of every call written by the runtime (L2), and the captured source records (L3). Because these views already exist, the runtime folds the context programmatically, selecting coarser views for older turns. item.title: 仅在美式手语上通过度量学习训练的姿态编码器无需任何目标语言训练，即可在六种低资源手语的词典检索中取得36.4%–80.7%的首位命中率，显著优于无学习方法与OpenHands等基线方法。
item.description:
低资源词典设置下的手语检索研究

Studies on Sign Language Retrieval in Low-Resource Dictionary Settings

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16621

仅在美式手语上通过度量学习训练的姿态编码器无需任何目标语言训练，即可在六种低资源手语的词典检索中取得36.4%–80.7%的首位命中率，显著优于无学习方法与OpenHands等基线方法。

大多数手语缺乏带标注的语料库，仅有小型词典，每个手语词条只有一段或几段示例视频。本研究考察了仅在单一手语上训练的姿态编码器，能否在不对目标语言进行任何训练的情况下服务于这类手语。该编码器在美式手语数据集ASL-Citizen上以度量学习方式训练后以冻结状态进行评估，测试对象涵盖土耳其、俄罗斯、印度、阿根廷、巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡六种手语数据集；每个词条注册一段或四段视频片段，并且在可获得打手语者身份信息时，将查询者本人的视频从候选库中排除。在仅注册一段视频的情况下，该编码器在36.4%–80.7%的查询中首位即检索到正确手语；相比之下，最优的无学习方法（基于角度的动态时间规整）为16.0%–69.6%，而在美式手语上训练的OpenHands图网络在六个目标数据集上的平均准确率为39.3%。在对编码器的交叉消融研究中（嵌入几何结构、身体与手部嵌入的聚合方式、训练……（原文摘要在此处中断）

arXiv:2611.16621v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most sign languages have no annotated corpus, only small dictionaries with one or a few example videos per sign. This study examines how well a pose encoder trained on a single sign language serves such languages without any target-language training. An encoder trained with metric learning on American Sign Language (ASL-Citizen) is evaluated frozen on six datasets of Turkish, Russian, Indian, Argentinian, Pakistani and Sri Lankan sign languages, with one or four clips per sign enrolled and, where signer identities are available, the query's signer excluded from the gallery. With one enrolled clip, the encoder retrieves the correct sign first in 36.4-80.7 % of queries, against 16.0-69.6 % for the best learning-free method (angle-based dynamic time warping) and a six-target mean of 39.3 % for an ASL-trained OpenHands graph network. item.title: 该论文提出一种结合解剖学信息图分支与EEGNet卷积分支的双分支网络，在上肢运动脑电分类中取得良好性能的同时，可通过学习到的图结构直接揭示模型所依赖的关键脑区域，实现可解释性。
item.description:
一种用于可解释运动脑电（EEG）分类的双分支图与卷积网络

A Dual-Branch Graph and Convolutional Network for Interpretable Movement EEG Classification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16609

该论文提出一种结合解剖学信息图分支与EEGNet卷积分支的双分支网络，在上肢运动脑电分类中取得良好性能的同时，可通过学习到的图结构直接揭示模型所依赖的关键脑区域，实现可解释性。

从头皮脑电图（EEG）中解码上肢运动是脑机接口（BCI）领域的一个重要问题，但许多深度学习模型对其预测所依赖的脑区域提供的洞察十分有限。我们提出了一种双分支架构，将受LGGNet启发的局部-全局图分支与EEGNet风格的卷积分支相结合，用于运动与静息状态的分类。图分支将61个EEG电极按照解剖学信息划分为若干脑区域，并学习这些区域之间的空间关系，从而直接呈现模型所重点关注的脑区域。我们在Ofner上肢运动数据集上采用留一被试交叉验证对该架构进行评估，模型在各被试上的平均F1分数达到0.74 ± 0.06。除了分类性能之外，我们还分析了学习到的图结构，以识别连接最强的脑区域。在所有留出的……

arXiv:2611.16609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Decoding upper-limb movements from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is an important problem for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), but many deep learning models provide limited insight into the brain regions underlying their predictions. We propose a two-branch architecture that combines an LGGNet-inspired local-global graph branch with an EEGNet-style convolutional branch for movement-versus-rest classification. The graph branch groups 61 EEG electrodes into anatomically informed regions and learns their spatial relationships, providing a direct representation of the regions emphasized by the model. We evaluate the proposed architecture using leave-one-subject-out cross-validation on the Ofner upper-limb movement dataset. The model achieves a mean F1-score of 0.74 +/- 0.06 across subjects. item.title: 该论文提出了开放式基准Singularity-Bench，通过六项覆盖AI开发全流程（从预训练到集群编排）的端到端任务，评估智能体能否从零实现核心AI系统并与人工工程基线对比，同时通过红队测试发现并修复了现有评估框架中的奖励破解漏洞。
item.description:
Singularity-Bench：智能体能构建智能体吗？

Singularity-Bench: Can Agents Build Agents?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16591

该论文提出了开放式基准Singularity-Bench，通过六项覆盖AI开发全流程（从预训练到集群编排）的端到端任务，评估智能体能否从零实现核心AI系统并与人工工程基线对比，同时通过红队测试发现并修复了现有评估框架中的奖励破解漏洞。

前沿AI智能体在现实的、长时程任务上正取得越来越多的成功，并且开始改进它们自身赖以运行的系统。然而，现有基准通常将智能体限制在狭窄的动作空间中，使用简化的环境，或依赖对评估任意智能体生成系统并不可靠的验证方法。我们提出了Singularity-Bench，一个面向自主AI开发的开放式基准，包含六项端到端任务，涵盖预训练、中期训练、后训练、推理、智能体框架以及集群编排。每项任务都要求智能体从一个极简起点实现核心系统，并在相同硬件条件下将其与成熟的人工工程基线进行评估比较。此外，通过覆盖OWASP智能体应用十大风险中10类中的9类的大规模红队测试，我们揭示了传统Harbor框架中的奖励破解漏洞，并开发了Breakwat（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.16591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier AI agents increasingly succeed on realistic, long-horizon tasks and are beginning to improve the systems through which they operate. Yet existing benchmarks often restrict agents to narrow action spaces, use simplified environments, or rely on verification methods that are unreliable for evaluating arbitrary agent-generated systems. We introduce Singularity-Bench, an open-ended benchmark for autonomous AI development with six end-to-end tasks spanning pre-training, mid-training, post-training, inference, the agent harness, and cluster orchestration. Each task requires agents to implement core systems from a minimal starting point and evaluates them against mature human-engineered baselines on identical hardware. Additionally, through extensive red-teaming covering 9 of the 10 categories in the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, we expose reward-hacking vulnerabilities in the conventional Harbor framework and develop Breakwat

arXiv:2611.16590v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-term spacecraft autonomy requires embodied agents to use operational history under communication delays, time-critical operations, environmental uncertainty, complex physical interactions, power and computational constraints, and safety and reliability requirements. We introduce AstroMemBench and a Scenario-Challenge-Capability design method that maps these requirements to executable memory tests. The benchmark covers 16 memory subchallenges through 140 templates and 2240 instances across nine tasks in planetary surface operations, on-orbit servicing, and deep-space exploration. A deterministic environment scores actions for task completion, state changes, safety, and resource use. Ablations under nine conditions show that the benchmark is sensitive to how accurately agents recover and use historical information and to differences in memory-system design. https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16586

该论文评估了GPT-4、Gemma、Llama 3.1和Mistral等大语言模型能否基于用户社交媒体帖子以“数字孪生”方式预测其在BFI-2-60大五人格问卷上的回答，并通过无用户文本和人群基线等分布感知对比方法，验证预测是否真正利用了用户写作中的信息。

本文研究大语言模型能否像特定个体那样回答人格问卷。给定用户的社交媒体帖子，模型以该用户的身份完成 BFI-2-60 大五人格问卷，并将预测的回答转换为特质分数，与用户的实际分数进行比较。研究者在 MyPersonality 数据集上评估了 GPT-4、Gemma、Llama 3.1 和 Mistral。为了确定预测是否反映了用户文本中的信息，他们将预测结果与无用户文本时生成的回答以及基于一般人群倾向得出的数值进行对比。研究测量了所有用户的预测误差，并分别针对低、中、高特质得分的个体进行分析。此外，研究还测试了在仅给定目标大五人格分数（无用户文本）的情况下，大语言模型能否表达出明确的人格特征，并考察了随着提供更多文本时预测结果的变化。结果表明，用户文本……

Given a user's social-media posts, the model completes the BFI-2-60 Big Five questionnaire as that user. The predicted responses are converted into trait scores and compared with the user's actual scores. We evaluate GPT-4, Gemma, Llama 3.1, and Mistral on the MyPersonality dataset. To determine whether predictions reflect information from the user's writing, we compare them with answers produced without user text and with values derived from general population tendencies. We measure prediction error across all users and separately for individuals with low, intermediate, and high trait scores. We also test whether an LLM can express an explicit personality profile when given only the target Big Five scores, without user text, and examine how predictions change as more text is provided. item.title: 该论文提出SPARC方法，通过为相似的激活向量组构建代表性向量并以高精度数字计算其内积、仅将范数更小的残差内积交给光子加速器处理，从而有效降低量化误差和模拟光子噪声对推理精度的影响。
item.description:
SPARC：通过代表性向量实现精确的光子矩阵乘法

SPARC: Accurate Photonic Matrix Multiplication via Representative Vectors

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16561

该论文提出SPARC方法，通过为相似的激活向量组构建代表性向量并以高精度数字计算其内积、仅将范数更小的残差内积交给光子加速器处理，从而有效降低量化误差和模拟光子噪声对推理精度的影响。

光子神经网络加速器已成为一种有前景的解决方案，通过在模拟光子硬件上执行矩阵乘法来降低深度神经网络（DNN）推理的功耗。然而，其推理精度受到光子处理所需的低位量化以及模拟光子噪声的限制。本文提出了一种通过利用DNN中激活向量之间的高度相似性来提高推理精度的方法。具体而言，我们的方法为每组相似的激活向量构建一个代表性向量，以高精度在数字域计算其内积，并将残差内积卸载到光子加速器上处理。由于每组内的激活向量高度相似，残差向量的范数要小得多，从而减轻了量化误差和模拟光子噪声的影响。此外，我们的方法保留了光子……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.16561v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photonic neural network accelerators have emerged as a promising solution for reducing the power consumption of deep neural network (DNN) inference by executing matrix multiplication on analog photonic hardware. However, their inference accuracy is limited by low-bit quantization required for photonic processing and by analog photonic noise. This paper proposes an approach for improving inference accuracy by exploiting the high similarity among activation vectors in DNNs. Specifically, our approach constructs a representative vector for each group of similar activation vectors, computes its inner product digitally with high precision, and offloads the residual inner products to the photonic accelerator. Since the activation vectors within each group are highly similar, the residual vectors have much smaller norms, thereby reducing the effects of quantization errors and analog photonic noise. item.title: 通过让三个大语言模型独立重新证明《几何原本》全部465个命题并与人类证明进行对比分析，研究发现AI生成的数学证明呈现出一种稳定、可复现且明显区别于人类证明的独特风格。
item.description:
AI在数学证明中拥有自己独特的风格

AI has its own style in mathematical proving

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16527

通过让三个大语言模型独立重新证明《几何原本》全部465个命题并与人类证明进行对比分析，研究发现AI生成的数学证明呈现出一种稳定、可复现且明显区别于人类证明的独特风格。

随着大语言模型越来越多地生成数学证明，它们是否发展出了一种区别于人类数学家的证明风格仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。随着数学家们日益表达对大语言模型所生成证明难以解读的担忧，这一问题尤为紧迫。在此，我们让三个大语言模型独立地重新证明欧几里得《几何原本》中的全部465个命题，并通过Jaccard相似度和复杂网络分析，将其引用选择与人类证明基线进行比较。我们发现AI生成的证明与人类证明存在差异，而且这种差异是稳定且可复现的：AI各次运行之间的平均成对Jaccard相似度（约0.68）几乎是AI与人类证明之间相似度（约0.37）的两倍，且跨运行的分类一致性也很高。通过详细考察引用结构，我们识别出了这种差异的具体特征……

arXiv:2611.16527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language models increasingly generate mathematical proofs, whether they develop a proving style distinct from that of human mathematicians remains an open question. This question is particularly pressing as mathematicians increasingly voice concerns that proofs generated by large language models are difficult to interpret. Here we ask three large language models to independently reprove all 465 propositions of Euclid's \textit{Elements} and compare their citation choices against the human-proof baseline through Jaccard similarity and complex network analysis. We find that AI-generated proofs differ from human proofs, and this difference is stable and reproducible: mean pairwise Jaccard similarity among AI runs (~0.68) is nearly twice that between AI and human proofs (~0.37), and cross-run classification consistency is also high. item.title: 本研究通过专门的截止日期前后数据集系统比较多种任务委派模式，发现LLM间的任务委派并不总能带来准确性提升——当任务涉及编排模型未知的信息时，委派反而会显著降低准确性，而直接进行工具调用的效果要好得多。
item.description:
委派中的迷失：研究生成式搜索中任务编排的有效性

Lost in Delegation: Studying the Effectiveness of Task Orchestration in Generative Search

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16526

本研究通过专门的截止日期前后数据集系统比较多种任务委派模式，发现LLM间的任务委派并不总能带来准确性提升——当任务涉及编排模型未知的信息时，委派反而会显著降低准确性，而直接进行工具调用的效果要好得多。

大语言模型（LLM）已从单独使用的模型迅速演变为能够将任务委派给外部工具和其他LLM以解决复杂任务的智能体系统。这种智能体式增强带来了令人瞩目的能力提升。然而，委派在何时以及如何提升性能仍然缺乏深入理解。例如，当任务涉及编排LLM无法从自身知识中可靠解决的截止日期后信息时，委派是否有帮助尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用专门构建的、带有截止日期前/后划分的数据集来比较各种委派模式。我们发现，与非委派设置相比，委派并不能带来一致的准确性提升，其效果因模型和任务而异。当任务涉及编排模型无法获取的知识时，委派可能大幅降低准确性，而使用同一个LLM直接调用工具的表现要好得多。我们的分析识别出失真的委派查询（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2611.16526v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLMs have quickly evolved from models used in isolation to agentic systems that delegate tasks to external tools and other LLMs to solve complex assignments. This agentic augmentation has led to impressive capability gains. However, when and how delegation improves performance remains poorly understood. For example, it is unclear whether delegation helps when tasks involve post-cutoff information that the orchestrating LLM cannot reliably resolve from its own knowledge. In this work, we use purpose-built datasets with pre- and post-cutoff splits to compare various delegation modes. We find that delegation provides no consistent accuracy improvement over non-delegated setups, with effects varying across models and tasks. When tasks involve knowledge unavailable to the orchestrator, delegation can substantially degrade accuracy, while direct tool use with the same LLM performs much better. item.title: ZONOS3-Mini 通过 886M 参数（每 token 仅激活 100M）的潜在 MoE 骨干网络和新型音频编解码器 ZAC-1，实现了可在笔记本和手机上实时运行的零样本语音克隆 TTS 模型，并在 55 个语言集合上取得 6.71% 宏平均 WER，达到与更大模型相当的先进水平。
item.description:
ZONOS3-Mini 技术报告

ZONOS3-Mini Technical Report

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16525

ZONOS3-Mini 通过 886M 参数（每 token 仅激活 100M）的潜在 MoE 骨干网络和新型音频编解码器 ZAC-1，实现了可在笔记本和手机上实时运行的零样本语音克隆 TTS 模型，并在 55 个语言集合上取得 6.71% 宏平均 WER，达到与更大模型相当的先进水平。

ZONOS3-Mini 是一款超紧凑、超快速的零样本语音克隆文本转语音（TTS）模型。该模型可以在笔记本电脑或智能手机上实时运行。以其延迟和模型规模而言，它实现了最先进的准确率和语音克隆保真度。为实现这一目标，我们提出了一个仅有 886M 参数（每个 token 仅激活 100M 参数）的潜在 MoE 骨干网络，以及一个全新的音频编解码器 Zyphra Audio Codec 1（ZAC-1），它能以 15 Hz 的帧率表示 44.1 kHz 的音频。在新的 ZTTS2-Eval 基准测试中，ZONOS3-Mini 在 55 个语言集合（35 个干净语音和 20 个真实场景语音）上取得了 6.71% 的宏平均词错误率（WER），与更大、更慢的最先进模型相比毫不逊色。我们已公开发布模型权重、推理和训练代码。

arXiv:2611.16525v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: ZONOS3-Mini is an ultra-compact, ultra-fast, zero-shot voice-cloning TTS model. The model can run in real time on a laptop or smartphone. For its latency and size, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and cloning fidelity. To achieve this we propose a latent MoE backbone with only 886M parameters (100M active per token) and a new audio codec, Zyphra Audio Codec 1 (ZAC-1), which represents 44.1 kHz audio at a 15 Hz frame rate. On the new ZTTS2-Eval benchmark, ZONOS3-Mini reaches a 6.71% macro-average WER over 55 language sets (35 clean and 20 in the wild), which is competitive with larger and slower state-of-the-art models. We release the model weights, inference, and training code.

item.title: 提出一种结合大语言模型推理与优化器的智能体辅助无人机调度系统，在能量约束下协调多架无人机执行野外受害者搜索任务，仿真证明其能持续完成任务，而六个非LLM基线方法均告失败。
item.description:
一种用于受害者搜索任务中无人机调度的LLM与优化联合智能体解决方案

A Joint LLM and Optimization Agent Solution for Drone Scheduling in Victim Search Missions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16524

提出一种结合大语言模型推理与优化器的智能体辅助无人机调度系统，在能量约束下协调多架无人机执行野外受害者搜索任务，仿真证明其能持续完成任务，而六个非LLM基线方法均告失败。

野外区域的受害者搜救具有很强的时间紧迫性。无人机能够实现快速的区域搜索，但调度无人机极具挑战性，因为受害者可能持续移动，检测结果存在不确定性，且有效的决策必须将结构化的任务信息与非结构化的上下文线索和领域知识相结合。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种智能体辅助的无人机调度系统。该系统在地面控制站（GCS）部署一个智能体，在连续的搜索周期中协调多架无人机。在每个周期中，该智能体采用一种调度策略，将大语言模型（LLM）用于推理“在哪里搜索”，同时利用优化器确定“如何在能量约束下派遣无人机”。仿真结果表明，所提出的系统能够持续完成受害者搜索任务，而六个非LLM基线方法均无法做到，直接使用LLM进行调度的可靠性也明显较低。

arXiv:2611.16524v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Victim search in wilderness areas is time-critical. Drones enable rapid area search, but scheduling them is challenging because victims may continue moving, detection results are uncertain, and effective decisions must combine structured mission information with unstructured contextual clues and domain knowledge. To address this, we propose an agent-aided drone scheduling system. The system employs an agent at the ground control station (GCS) to coordinate multiple drones over successive search cycles. In each cycle, the agent applies a scheduling policy that combines a large language model (LLM) for reasoning about where to search with an optimizer for determining how to dispatch the drones under energy constraints. Simulation results show that the proposed system consistently completes the victim-search mission, whereas none of the six non-LLM baselines does so and direct LLM scheduling is considerably less reliable. item.title: RESYNC 让大模型异步运行，并用快速更新器根据新到达的观测值刷新其潜在状态，从而在满足流式推理截止期限的同时保留大模型的预测优势。
item.description:
RESYNC：面向截止期限约束流式推理的残差潜在状态同步

RESYNC: Residual Latent-State Synchronization for Deadline-Bound Streaming Inference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16523

RESYNC 让大模型异步运行，并用快速更新器根据新到达的观测值刷新其潜在状态，从而在满足流式推理截止期限的同时保留大模型的预测优势。

预测高速率数据流中的每一个观测值，要求模型必须在下一个数据到达之前完成计算。大模型可能提供更好的预测，但会错过这一截止期限。我们提出 RESYNC：大模型异步运行，同时由一条快速路径利用自该状态计算以来新接收到的观测值，对其最新但已过时的精确潜在状态进行更新，并应用其保持不变的预测头。该更新器无需任务标签，直接从冻结模型学到的表示中进行学习。在一个真实数据流和两个合成数据流以及五种架构家族的实验中，RESYNC 在全部十二个数据集--架构配对中以配对95%置信区间高于零的优势超越了最佳的紧凑模型或蒸馏替代方案，在锚定年龄为 4--12 个观测值时教师优势显著；在测试年龄最高达 32 的较老锚定年龄下，十二个配对中仍有十一个保持优势。在真实数据流上所保留的教师收益份额保持完整，但在合成数据流上较低，且通常随锚定年龄的增加而下降。

arXiv:2611.16523v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting every observation in a high-rate stream requires a model to finish before the next arrival. A large model may offer better predictions but miss that deadline. We propose RESYNC: the large model runs asynchronously, while a fast path updates its latest exact but stale latent state using the observations received since that state was computed and applies its unchanged prediction head. The updater learns from the frozen model's representations without task labels. Across one real and two synthetic streams and five architecture families, RESYNC beats the best compact or distilled alternative with a paired 95% interval above zero in all twelve dataset--architecture pairs with a material teacher advantage at anchor ages of 4--12 observations, and in eleven pairs at older tested ages up to 32. item.title: PISim 是一个统一的光子推理模拟器，它将预训练深度神经网络执行与涵盖六种加速器架构、六种电光调制器技术、四种光源组织方式及直接/相干读出方案的物理模型相耦合，从而支持制造前的硬件感知跨层设计空间探索。
item.description:
PISim：面向硬件感知跨层设计空间探索的统一光子推理模拟器

PISim: A Unified Photonic Inference Simulator for Hardware-Aware Cross-Layer Design-Space Exploration

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16522

PISim 是一个统一的光子推理模拟器，它将预训练深度神经网络执行与涵盖六种加速器架构、六种电光调制器技术、四种光源组织方式及直接/相干读出方案的物理模型相耦合，从而支持制造前的硬件感知跨层设计空间探索。

光子神经加速器能够提供超低延迟的线性代数运算，然而其可用的数值精度、可持续吞吐量与应用精度仍受到周边电光接口和物理非理想性的严格制约。制造前的设计空间探索（DSE）需要一个跨层电子设计自动化（EDA）框架，能够在相同的神经网络工作负载和物理假设下评估不同的光学拓扑结构。我们提出了 PISim——一个统一的光子推理模拟器，它将预训练深度神经网络的执行与基于物理的模型相耦合，涵盖六种加速器架构系列、六种电光调制器技术、四种光学光源组织方式，以及直接或相干读出方案。PISim 内嵌了按阶段解析的损伤算子——涵盖控制与模数转换量化、有限消光比、散粒噪声、相关相对强度噪声等（摘要原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.16522v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Photonic neural accelerators offer ultra-low latency linear algebra, yet their usable numerical precision, sustainable throughput, and application accuracy remain tightly bounded by surrounding electro-optical interfaces and physical non-idealities. Pre-fabrication design-space exploration (DSE) requires a cross-layer electronic design automation (EDA) framework capable of evaluating disparate optical topologies under identical neural workloads and physical assumptions. We present \textbf{PISim}, a unified Photonic Inference Simulator that couples pretrained deep neural network execution with physics-based models of six accelerator architecture families, six electro-optic modulator technologies, four optical source organizations, and direct or coherent readout schemes. PISim embeds stage-resolved impairment operators---covering control and analog-to-digital quantization, finite extinction ratio, shot noise, correlated relative-intensit

item.title: 提出SignRot方法，通过大规模离群值感知的符号调整旋转，解决大语言模型量化中大规模离群值引起的激活分布碎片化问题，并克服了下投影输入处旋转必须在线应用的训练难题。
item.description:
SignRot：面向大语言模型量化的大规模离群值感知符号调整旋转方法

SignRot: LLM Quantization with Massive Outlier-Aware Sign-Adjusted Rotation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16502

提出SignRot方法，通过大规模离群值感知的符号调整旋转，解决大语言模型量化中大规模离群值引起的激活分布碎片化问题，并克服了下投影输入处旋转必须在线应用的训练难题。

虽然量化能够压缩大语言模型并加速推理，但离群值激活阻碍了高效的低比特表示。尤其是大规模离群值会导致显著的性能下降。尽管基于随机化Hadamard变换的旋转方法通过在线推理力求缓解该问题，但当大规模离群值主导某个token的激活时，这些方法会产生带有空桶的碎片化分布。这种碎片化严重破坏了均匀量化的性能。此外，大规模离群值集中在下投影的输入处，其前方的非线性要求旋转必须在推理时进行。这一约束使得SpinQuant等基于训练的方法无法在该位置学习在线旋转，因为学习到的稠密矩阵无法使用快速Walsh-Hadamard变换，并且在推理时需要执行完整的矩阵乘法。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SignRot……

arXiv:2611.16502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While quantization compresses LLMs and accelerates inference, outlier activations impede efficient low-bit representation. In particular, massive outliers cause substantial performance degradation. Although rotation-based methods that rely on randomized Hadamard transforms for online inference aim to mitigate this, they can produce fragmented distributions with empty bins when a massive outlier dominates a token's activation. This fragmentation severely undermines uniform quantization performance. Moreover, massive outliers concentrate in the down-projection input, where the preceding nonlinearity requires the rotation to be applied at inference time. This constraint prevents training-based approaches such as SpinQuant from learning the online rotation at this position, as a learned dense matrix cannot use the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform and would require a full matrix multiplication during inference. item.title: 本文提供了一个用130行numpy代码、五步流程重新校准Laya类型化决策模型置信度的实用教程，揭示总体ECE会掩盖相互抵消的分桶级校准误差，并表明按桶交叉拟合的温度缩放比单一全局温度更有效。
item.description:
一个下午重新校准类型化决策模型：Laya置信度分数的实用指南

Recalibrating a Typed-Decision Model in an Afternoon: A Hands-On Recipe for Laya's Confidence Scores

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16499

本文提供了一个用130行numpy代码、五步流程重新校准Laya类型化决策模型置信度的实用教程，揭示总体ECE会掩盖相互抵消的分桶级校准误差，并表明按桶交叉拟合的温度缩放比单一全局温度更有效。

诸如Laya之类的类型化决策模型读取一段文本以及调用者定义的选项列表（例如工单类别），并为每个选项返回一个概率。围绕该模型的代码将最高概率与阈值进行比较，以决定是回答、弃权还是升级给人工处理。早前的工作曾报告，对于一个土耳其语模型，温度缩放可能会提高留出集上的校准误差（ECE）。本教程提供了一个五步操作流程（测量、诊断、拟合、验证、部署），仅用130行numpy代码和标准方法实现，没有引入任何新方法。在1,065个由大语言模型标注的合成数据项上，已发布的Laya检查点的总体ECE为0.073，但分桶宏平均ECE为0.143（0.127-0.184），即各桶（按问题类型和选项数量分组）的平均值：12选项桶过于自信+0.22，三至五选项桶不够自信-0.05，两者相互抵消。单一全局温度会使总体ECE恶化（0.173）；而每个桶采用交叉拟合的温度……

arXiv:2611.16499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A typed-decision model such as Laya reads a text and a list of options that the caller defines, for example ticket categories, and returns a probability for each option. Code around it compares the top probability with a threshold to answer, abstain or escalate to a person. Earlier work reports, for a Turkish model, that temperature scaling can raise held-out calibration error (ECE). This tutorial gives a five-step recipe (measure, diagnose, fit, validate, deploy) in 130 lines of numpy with standard methods, none new. On 1,065 synthetic, LLM-labelled items the released Laya checkpoint has a pooled ECE of 0.073 but a bucket-macro ECE of 0.143 (0.127-0.184), the mean over buckets (questions grouped by type and option count): the 12-option bucket is over-confident by +0.22, the three-to-five-option bucket under-confident by 0.05, and they cancel. One global temperature makes pooled ECE worse (0.173); a cross-fitted temperature per bucket br

item.title: 决策编码器 Laya 仅用少量 LLM 标注数据即可显著提升准确率（5% 数据从 69.4% 升至 74.3%），但收益随数据量增加而趋于饱和，且随机种子差异和标签噪声对结果的影响不可忽视。
item.description:
决策编码器需要多少条 LLM 标注的数据行？这些标签可以错到什么程度？

How many LLM-labelled rows does a decision encoder need, and how wrong can the labels be?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16498

决策编码器 Laya 仅用少量 LLM 标注数据即可显著提升准确率（5% 数据从 69.4% 升至 74.3%），但收益随数据量增加而趋于饱和，且随机种子差异和标签噪声对结果的影响不可忽视。

诸如 Laya 之类的决策编码器会读取一个带有命名选项的问题（例如，哪个部门应该处理某个工单）和一段文本，并从中选择一个选项。它在一次前向传播中同时读取两者，并为每个选项返回一个概率，而不生成任何文本。我们探究这样一个编码器需要多少条由 LLM 撰写的训练数据行，以及这些标签可能错到什么程度。我们在一个包含 2,818 行数据的池的嵌套子集上对 Laya（ModernBERT-large）进行了 19 次微调，并在来自同一生成器的 1,065 个保留测试项上进行评分，因此每个测试项都在分布之内，且没有进行分布外测试。准确率从微调前的 69.4% 提升至使用 5% 数据行时的 74.3%、使用 50% 数据行时的 84.8%，以及使用全部数据行时的 86.9%。曲线趋于平缓，而带有自助法置信区间的饱和拟合也无法确定其平台期。在 20% 数据行时的随机种子差异（标准差 1.6 个百分点）超过了某些数据规模之间的提升幅度。给予小规模子集与全量数据池相同数量的更新步数可获得 1.9 个百分点的收益。

arXiv:2611.16498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A decision encoder such as Laya reads a question with named options (for example, which department should handle a ticket) and a text, and picks an option. It reads both in one forward pass and returns a probability for every option, without writing any text. We ask how many LLM-written training rows such an encoder needs and how wrong those labels may be. We ran 19 fine-tunes of Laya (ModernBERT-large) on nested subsets of a 2,818-row pool and scored them on 1,065 held-out items from the same generator, so every test item is in-distribution and no out-of-family test was run. Accuracy rises from 69.4% before fine-tuning to 74.3% with 5% of the rows, 84.8% with 50% and 86.9% with all rows. The curve flattens, and a saturating fit with bootstrap intervals cannot pin down its plateau. Seed spread at 20% of the rows (s.d. 1.6 points) exceeds some of the steps between sizes. Giving small subsets as many updates as the full pool gains 1.9 poin

item.title: 提出了ReA-Bench——首个针对负责任智能体审计的诊断性基准测试，能够深入揭示审计系统遗漏了哪些风险、以及审计失败的具体原因（如忽略证据、结论缺乏依据或信息不足）。
item.description:
ReA-Bench：负责任智能体审计基准测试

ReA-Bench: Benchmarking Responsible Agent Auditing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16493

提出了ReA-Bench——首个针对负责任智能体审计的诊断性基准测试，能够深入揭示审计系统遗漏了哪些风险、以及审计失败的具体原因（如忽略证据、结论缺乏依据或信息不足）。

随着智能体在本地和云环境中自主执行任务，审计其执行轨迹可以帮助服务提供商识别风险，并改进智能体框架和基础模型。我们对生产环境和红队测试轨迹的分析表明，某些风险在各种审计配置下会被反复遗漏。总体召回率掩盖了哪些风险被遗漏，以及更高的召回率是否伴随着对合法行为的更多误报。现有基准测试对此类失败提供的洞察有限：生成的轨迹可能包含不一致的工具调用与响应、显而易见的风险行为或重复的攻击模式；而按风险类型对结果进行分组，也难以判断审计者是忽略了证据、接受了缺乏依据的结论，还是缺乏做出判断所需的信息。我们提出了ReA-Bench，一个用于审计负责任智能体行为的诊断性基准测试。它对审计……（摘要在此处截断，后续内容不完整）

arXiv:2611.16493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As agents perform tasks autonomously in local and cloud environments, auditing their execution trajectories can help service providers identify risks and improve agent harnesses and foundation models. Our analysis of production and red-team trajectories shows that some risks are repeatedly missed across auditing configurations. Overall recall obscures which risks are missed and whether higher recall comes with more false positives on legitimate behavior. Existing benchmarks offer limited insight into these failures. Generated trajectories can contain inconsistent tool calls and responses, conspicuous risky actions, or repetitive attack patterns. Grouping results by risk type also makes it difficult to tell whether auditors overlooked evidence, accepted an unsupported conclusion, or lacked information needed to make a judgment. We introduce ReA-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for auditing responsible agent behavior. It organizes auditing

item.title: 提出面向个人智能体的“时空上下文（STC）”双轴表示框架——时间轴承载事件时间与有效区间、空间轴为语义实体关系图，所有关系锚定于不可变源记录并辅以六条不变式、上下文算子、歧义保留消解状态机与冲突检测器，使智能体的回答可追溯至证据并解决实体指代、时间有效性与来源授权问题。
item.description:
时间与空间：面向个人智能体的双轴、证据锚定的上下文基底

Time and Space: A Dual-Axis, Evidence-Grounded Context Substrate for Personal Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16492

提出面向个人智能体的“时空上下文（STC）”双轴表示框架——时间轴承载事件时间与有效区间、空间轴为语义实体关系图，所有关系锚定于不可变源记录并辅以六条不变式、上下文算子、歧义保留消解状态机与冲突检测器，使智能体的回答可追溯至证据并解决实体指代、时间有效性与来源授权问题。

我们认为，个人智能体的关键约束并不在于模型容量，而在于上下文被表示的形式：智能体不知道某个短语指代哪个实体、某个事实在何时成立、或者哪条源记录为某个论断提供依据。我们将这种缺失的表示称为时空上下文（STC），并在两个轴上对其进行定义。时间轴承载事件时间、有效区间和摄取时间。空间轴则是一个关系空间：实体是其中的点，类型化关系是边，距离是语义意义上的而非地理意义上的；物理地点只是众多实体类型中的一种。每条关系都锚定于不可变的源记录，且每个答案都必须在这些记录上闭合。我们对该基底及六条不变式进行了形式化，提出了一个将时间求交与关系扩展组合而成的上下文算子、一个保留歧义的消解状态机，以及一个将互斥事实转化为……的冲突检测器（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2611.16492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We argue that a binding constraint for personal agents is not model capacity but the form in which context is represented: the agent does not know which entity a phrase denotes, when a fact held, or which source record licenses a claim. We call the missing representation spatio-temporal context (STC) and define it on two axes. The temporal axis carries event time, validity intervals and ingestion time. The spatial axis is a relational space in which entities are points, typed relations are edges, and distance is semantic rather than geographic; physical places are one entity type among many. Every relation is anchored to immutable source records, and every answer must be closed over those records. We formalise the substrate and six invariants, a context operator that composes temporal intersection with relational expansion, an ambiguity-preserving resolution state machine, a conflict detector that converts mutually exclusive facts into u

item.title: HeMeR提出了一种推理框架，通过在动态更新的异构记忆（声明性、程序性和工作记忆）上下文与可复用KV状态之间进行结构化协调，实现对未变化记忆内容的选择性KV缓存复用，避免不必要的完整KV重算，从而加速具身智能体的连续决策推理。
item.description:
HeMeR：基于结构化KV复用的具身智能体异构记忆协调框架

HeMeR: Heterogeneous Memory Reconciliation for Embodied Agents via Structured KV Reuse

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16487

HeMeR提出了一种推理框架，通过在动态更新的异构记忆（声明性、程序性和工作记忆）上下文与可复用KV状态之间进行结构化协调，实现对未变化记忆内容的选择性KV缓存复用，避免不必要的完整KV重算，从而加速具身智能体的连续决策推理。

具身智能体通过组合来自异构记忆模块的信息进行决策，这些模块包括存储显性知识的声明性记忆、存储已学习例程的程序性记忆，以及存储当前观察的工作记忆。在交互过程中，决策所需的记忆内容会随智能体的状态、目标和任务进展而变化，同时许多内容在连续决策之间保持共享。然而，现有记忆模块通常通过相互独立的接口访问，导致每次更新的记忆上下文往往被当作全新输入交给基础模型处理。这使得系统无法对未变化的记忆内容进行选择性的键值（KV）缓存复用，即使大部分记忆上下文仍然有效，也必须进行完整的KV缓存重算。我们提出了HeMeR，一个在动态更新的记忆上下文与可复用KV状态之间执行KV协调的推理框架。HeMeR对声明性、程序性和工作记忆进行跟踪……

arXiv:2611.16487v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Embodied agents make decisions by combining information from heterogeneous memory modules, including declarative memory for explicit knowledge, procedural memory for learned routines, and working memory for current observations. During interaction, the memory contents required for decision making change with the agent's state, goal, and task progress, while many contents remain shared across consecutive decisions. However, existing memory modules are typically accessed through separate interfaces, so each updated memory context is often processed as a new input to the foundation model. This prevents selective key-value (KV) cache reuse for unchanged memory contents and forces full KV cache recomputation even when much of the memory context remains valid. We introduce HeMeR, an inference framework that performs KV reconciliation between dynamically updated memory contexts and reusable KV states. HeMeR tracks declarative, procedural, and w

item.title: 本文提出了 drydock-eval——一个快速、安全且与托管评分器高度一致的本地评估套件，通过无网络的容器隔离、八项配置符合性检查和配对统计三大模块，以红队测试加 AI 智能体自主构建与攻击的方式评估小型编码智能体，并公开了包含 9,660 行运行数据在内的完整实验记录。
item.description:
遏制、符合、比较（扩展版）：一个面向小型编码智能体的红队评估套件及其完整实验记录

Contain, Conform, Compare (Extended Version): A Red-Teamed Evaluation Kit for Small Coding Agents and the Full Record of Its Experiments

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16485

本文提出了 drydock-eval——一个快速、安全且与托管评分器高度一致的本地评估套件，通过无网络的容器隔离、八项配置符合性检查和配对统计三大模块，以红队测试加 AI 智能体自主构建与攻击的方式评估小型编码智能体，并公开了包含 9,660 行运行数据在内的完整实验记录。

Gemma 4 开发者智能体竞赛中的托管评分只是一个含噪声的单一数字，因此开发过程需要一个本地评估器，它要足够快速、对智能体编写的代码安全，并且与托管评分器的提示词保持一致。drydock-eval 在单张 RTX 5090 上以每小时约 250 次运行的速度评估小型编码智能体（Gemma 4 E4B）。Contain（遏制）模块在没有网络的全新容器中运行每个任务，并通过了 200 个脚本化逃逸测试；Conform（符合）模块提供八项检查，将本地技术栈的请求与评分器的配置进行对比，精确到渲染后的 token；Compare（比较）模块提供尊重仓库聚类结构的配对统计。AI 智能体构建并攻击了这个评估套件，由人类所有者批准机器使用与发布。本扩展版重复了短论文的内容，并添加了使用该套件及围绕该套件开展的实验的完整记录：9,660 行智能体运行数据、2,494 项评分控制记录和 72 次服务测量，全部公开发布。在四块 L4 GPU 上，31B 模型的解码速度为每秒 38.1 个 token。

arXiv:2611.16485v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A hosted score in the Gemma 4 Developer Agent competition is one noisy number, so development needs a local evaluator that is fast, safe for agent-written code, and matching the hosted scorer's prompts. drydock-eval evaluates a small coding agent (Gemma 4 E4B) at about 250 runs per hour on one RTX 5090. Contain runs each job in a fresh container without network and passed 200 scripted escape tests; conform provides eight checks that compare a local stack's requests with the scorer's configuration, down to rendered tokens; compare provides paired statistics that respect repository clusters. AI agents built and attacked the kit; a human owner approved machine use and release. This extended version repeats the short paper and adds the full record of the experiments made with and around the kit: 9,660 rows of agent runs, 2,494 grading controls and 72 serving measurements, all released. On four L4 GPUs the 31B model decodes 38.1 tokens per se

item.title: 该论文提出一种无需训练、仅需一次额外前向传播的方法，利用同一权重8比特与低精度量化副本之间的分歧作为逐题错误评分信号来检测小语言模型的错误，但实验发现其最佳分歧评分（AUROC 0.684）仅与8比特回答的熵（0.682）表现相当。
item.description:
一个模型，两种精度：量化副本之间的分歧能否告诉你小模型何时出错？

One Model, Two Precisions: Does Disagreement Between Quantized Copies Tell You When a Small Model Is Wrong?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16478

该论文提出一种无需训练、仅需一次额外前向传播的方法，利用同一权重8比特与低精度量化副本之间的分歧作为逐题错误评分信号来检测小语言模型的错误，但实验发现其最佳分歧评分（AUROC 0.684）仅与8比特回答的熵（0.682）表现相当。

本地语言模型通常以多种精度存在，而量化已知会改变模型的个别回答。本研究探讨同一权重的两种精度之间的分歧——一个负责回答的8比特副本和一个读取相同提示的低精度副本——能否作为逐问题的错误评分，用于弃答、升级和重新提问。其成本仅为对更少字节数进行一次额外的前向传播，无需采样，也无需训练。我们在Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B上模拟了带分组缩放的舍入到最近邻量化（3至6比特，每组32至256），并对来自ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、MMLU和HellaSwag子集的8,398道选择题进行评分。错误检测通过AUROC、风险-覆盖曲线以及在留出一半数据上的ECE来衡量，并采用基于问题的成对自助法区间进行统计评估。对于Qwen3-0.6B，8比特回答的熵达到AUROC 0.682；在开发集一半数据上选出的最佳分歧评分达到0.684。

arXiv:2611.16478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local language models often exist at several precisions, and quantization is known to change individual answers. This study asks whether the disagreement between two precisions of the same weights, an 8-bit copy that answers and a lower-precision copy that reads the same prompt, works as a per-question error score for abstention, escalation and re-asking. The cost is one extra forward pass over fewer bytes, with no sampling and no training. We simulate round-to-nearest quantization with per-group scales (3 to 6 bits, groups of 32 to 256) on Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B and score 8,398 multiple-choice questions from ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag subsets. Error detection is measured by AUROC, risk-coverage curves and ECE on a held-out half, with paired bootstrap intervals over questions. For Qwen3-0.6B, the entropy of the 8-bit answer reaches AUROC 0.682; the best disagreement score, selected on a development half, reaches 0.684

item.title: 该论文通过系统性实验发现，单遍决策编码器Laya在证据文本超出512 token窗口被截断时，准确率降至接近随机猜测水平，且模型置信度与运行时截断标志均无法有效预警这种失效。
item.description:
单遍决策编码器在输入中的哪些位置进行关注？

Where in the Input Does a One-Pass Decision Encoder Look?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16477

该论文通过系统性实验发现，单遍决策编码器Laya在证据文本超出512 token窗口被截断时，准确率降至接近随机猜测水平，且模型置信度与运行时截断标志均无法有效预警这种失效。

Laya是一个小型模型，能够在单遍处理中回答关于文本的多选题：问题、选项（每个选项包含一个名称和描述）以及文本共同构成一个最多512个token的序列（即“窗口”），这是英文版本的处理方式。较长的文本会在末尾被静默截断，我们测量了这种截断所付出的代价。测试文档将一行保留文本（即证据）放置在干扰文本中的指定token偏移位置；实验共包含177个条目、五个任务、三个检查点（发布版、短行微调版、长文档微调版）、四种窗口大小，总计93,275个评分请求。当证据位于窗口之外时，发布版检查点的准确率降至26.4%（两个微调版均为27.2%），接近27.0%的随机猜测水平，低于35.6%的“总是给出最常见标签”基线。置信度没有提供任何警告（区分截断请求与完整读取请求的AUROC仅为0.50至0.55；0.5即随机水平），且运行时的截断标志也会在证据已被截断的请求上触发……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.16477v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Laya is a small model that answers a multiple-choice question about a text in one pass: the question, the options (each with a name and a description) and the text form one sequence of at most 512 tokens, the window, in the English release. A longer text is silently cut at the end, and we measure what that costs. Test documents place a held-out row's text, the evidence, at a chosen token offset among distractor text; 177 items, five tasks, three checkpoints (released, short-row fine-tune, long-document fine-tune), four window sizes and 93,275 scored requests. When the evidence lies beyond the window, accuracy falls to 26.4% for the released checkpoint (27.2% for both fine-tunes), near the 27.0% of guessing and below the 35.6% of always giving the commonest label. Confidence gives no warning (AUROC 0.50 to 0.55 for telling cut from read requests; 0.5 = chance), and the runtime's truncation flag also fires on requests whose evidence was

item.title: 本文回顾了社交机器人语音识别与话轮转换的改进历程，指出尽管语音识别已大幅进步，话轮转换失败仍普遍存在，并提出需要多模态双向流式处理来减少此类失败。
item.description:
说得太多、听得不够的机器人

Robots That Talk Too Much and Don't Listen Enough

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16473

本文回顾了社交机器人语音识别与话轮转换的改进历程，指出尽管语音识别已大幅进步，话轮转换失败仍普遍存在，并提出需要多模态双向流式处理来减少此类失败。

直到最近，与社交机器人进行自然口语交互的最大障碍是语音识别错误和话轮转换失败。语音识别技术的进步已使口语交互质量大幅提升，但话轮转换失败和其他误解仍然过于普遍。这篇短文回顾了早期改善社交机器人交互中语音识别和话轮转换的方法，进而探讨当前可以采取的措施，并论证需要采用多模态双向流式处理来降低话轮转换失败的发生频率。

arXiv:2611.16473v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Until recently, the biggest obstacles to natural spoken interaction with social robots were speech recognition errors and turn-taking failures. Advances in speech recognition have enabled much better spoken interaction, but turn-taking failures and other misunderstandings continue to be far too prevalent. This short paper looks back at earlier methods for improving speech recognition and turn-taking in interaction with social robots, and then looks at what can be done today, arguing that multimodal bidirectional streaming is needed to reduce the frequency of turn-taking failures.

item.title: 本文提出 ReSHAPE 任务来评估规划智能体通过交互修订用户请求、重塑搜索空间的能力，发现一个正确的权衡能使规划器找到可接受方案的概率提升至多 4.6 倍，但现有智能体的搜索空间最多只覆盖 32% 的可接受方案。
item.description:
规划智能体应如何重塑其搜索空间？

How Should Planning Agents ReSHAPE Their Search Space?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16466

本文提出 ReSHAPE 任务来评估规划智能体通过交互修订用户请求、重塑搜索空间的能力，发现一个正确的权衡能使规划器找到可接受方案的概率提升至多 4.6 倍，但现有智能体的搜索空间最多只覆盖 32% 的可接受方案。

规划智能体和基准测试通常将用户的初始规格视为固定不变。然而用户写下的请求往往排除了他们本乐意接受的方案，因为他们在看到可选选项之前，很少能发现自己愿意接受的各种权衡。尽管智能体已经能够通过交互修订请求，但这种做法是否有助于规划尚不清楚。我们将这一步骤形式化为 ReSHAPE 任务，该任务通过修订后的搜索空间是否与可接受方案相匹配、以及规划器能否在其中找到可接受方案来评判修订的质量。我们利用 ReSHAPE Planter（基于规划基准构建实例，并采用经人工验证的模拟用户）分析了旅行和购物场景中 5,800 个由智能体修订的规格说明。研究发现，重塑搜索空间确实很重要：一个正确的权衡能让同一个规划器找到可接受方案的概率提升至多 4.6 倍，且搜索空间的质量可以预测规划器能找到什么。然而，当前智能体的搜索空间最多只包含 32% 的可接受方案，而单凭那一个权衡就能包含……

arXiv:2611.16466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Planning agents and benchmarks treat a user's initial specification as fixed. Yet the requests users write exclude plans they would gladly take, since they rarely discover the possible trade-offs they would accept until seeing the options. Agents already revise requests through interaction, but whether this helps planning is unknown. We formalize this step as the ReSHAPE task, which judges a revision by whether its search space matches the acceptable plans and a planner finds one there. Using ReSHAPE Planter, which builds instances from planning benchmarks with a human-validated simulated user, we analyze 5,800 agent-revised specifications in travel and shopping. We find that reshaping matters: one correct trade-off makes the same planner reach an acceptable plan up to 4.6x as often, and search space quality predicts what the planner finds. item.title: 本文提出通过对微软Phi-2小语言模型进行监督微调来生成合成临床数据，以增强医疗数据集并改进远程监测生命体征的深度学习预测模型。
item.description:
微调小语言模型用于合成临床数据生成与预测性医疗分析

Fine-Tuned Small Language Model for Synthetic Clinical Data Generation and Predictive Healthcare Analytics

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16460

本文提出通过对微软Phi-2小语言模型进行监督微调来生成合成临床数据，以增强医疗数据集并改进远程监测生命体征的深度学习预测模型。

医疗数据集可获得性的降低是远程医疗解决方案预测模型开发中的一个重要挑战，特别是当可用数据不平衡或难以通过传统方法进行扩展时。小语言模型（SLMs）由于其较低的计算需求和对专业任务的适应性，已成为解决这些局限性的大语言模型（LLMs）的有前景的替代方案。然而，其性能仍然高度依赖于可用训练数据的质量和代表性。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于微调微软Phi-2模型的临床数据增强方法，该方法用于生成合成实例，旨在改进基于深度学习的远程监测生命体征预测模型。Phi-2模型通过在MedQuad数据集上进行监督微调来适应医疗领域。

arXiv:2611.16460v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The reduced availability of medical datasets represents an important challenge in the development of predictive models for remote healthcare solutions, especially when the available data are imbalanced or difficult to extend through traditional methods. Small Language Models (SLMs) have become a promising alternative to Large Language Models (LLMs) for addressing these limitations due to their lower computational requirements and adaptability to specialized tasks. However, their performance remains highly dependent on the quality and representativeness of the available training data. In this paper, we propose a method for clinical data augmentation based on a fine-tuned Microsoft Phi-2 model that is used to generate synthetic instances, with the purpose of improving deep learning-based model for predicting remotely monitored vital signs. The Phi-2 model was adapted to the medical domain through supervised fine-tuning on the MedQuad datas

item.title: 该论文提出了基于辩论机制实现超级智能理性对齐的框架，证明当智能体进行深入推理并按子博弈完美均衡方式行动时，能够产生更可预测且在某些情况下更有利于人类的结果。
item.description:
通过辩论实现超级智能的理性对齐

Rational Alignments of Superintelligences via Debates

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16455

该论文提出了基于辩论机制实现超级智能理性对齐的框架，证明当智能体进行深入推理并按子博弈完美均衡方式行动时，能够产生更可预测且在某些情况下更有利于人类的结果。

人工超级智能（ASI）是具有更强能力的人工智能。然而，由于人类委托人必须使用它，我们必须确保智能体能够以人类的利益为出发点行事。我们研究了ASI辅助问答的框架，其中ASI智能体知道正确答案而人类不知道。我们提供了几个理性对齐机制的示例，其中智能体的效用保持不变，但智能体与人类委托人之间的交互被控制为某种特定方式。我们特别表明，在一个辩论框架中，智能体可以进行进一步推理并以子博弈完美均衡的方式行动，这将带来更可预测的结果，并且在某些情况下是有利的。

arXiv:2611.16455v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial superintelligences (ASI) is artificial intelligences with greater capability. However, as human principal has to use it, we have to ensure that the agent will perform in the interest of the human. We investigate the framework of ASI-assisted question answering where ASI agents know the correct answer but the human does not. We provide some example of mechanism for rational alignment, where the agent utility is unchanged, but the interaction between the agent and the human principal is controlled to be in a certain fashion. We show specifically that a debate framework where the agents can further reason and behave in a subgame perfect equilibrium manner will lead to a more predictable result, and in some case will be favorable.

item.title: 该论文提出FPSRG方法，通过第一人称后训练使模型以参与者身份作答，再利用维度特定控制向量构建可按多维目标分数检索的模型配置目录，从而实现大语言模型的高效异质用户模拟。
item.description:
FPSRG：面向异质用户模拟的第一人称后训练与多维语义响应网格

FPSRG: Heterogeneous User Simulation First-Person Post-Training and Multidimensional Semantic Response Grids

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16445

该论文提出FPSRG方法，通过第一人称后训练使模型以参与者身份作答，再利用维度特定控制向量构建可按多维目标分数检索的模型配置目录，从而实现大语言模型的高效异质用户模拟。

用大语言模型模拟异质个体是一个活跃的研究方向，异质用户模拟需要具有不同特征的模型。我们研究画像构建问题：在给定维度、条目和评分规则的情况下，构建能够通过多维目标分数进行检索的模型配置。我们提出了第一人称语义响应网格。共享后训练首先教会模型以参与者的身份进行判断和作答；随后利用自我报告和行为目标来细化针对特定维度的控制向量。在模型冻结的情况下，我们测量各向量-系数组合的联合分数，过滤掉不可接受的配置，并将结果存储在可搜索的目录中。逐词元配置路由、连续批处理和隔离缓存支持对不同画像的并行测量。非思考模式的五维和十维Qwen实例以及思考模式的六维实例……

arXiv:2611.16445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating heterogeneous individuals with large language models is an active research direction, and heterogeneous user simulation requires models with different characteristics. We study profile construction: given dimensions, items, and scoring rules, build model configurations that can be retrieved by multidimensional target scores. We introduce First-Person Semantic Response Grids (FPSRG). Shared post-training first teaches the model to judge and answer as the participant; self-report and behavioral targets then refine dimension-specific control vectors. With the model frozen, we measure joint scores for vector-coefficient combinations, filter inadmissible configurations, and store the results in a searchable catalog. Per-token configuration routing, continuous batching, and isolated caches support parallel measurement of different profiles.
